entries.text: External walls and socle - ventilated facade (basalt wool 100 mm, rho <= 50)
Parapet insulation - RECLASSIFIED as a non-energy investment (see the non-EE list, item 4)
Roof insulation (XPS 2 x 100 mm, flat PVC-membrane roof) incl. dismantling of the old pitched roof
Floor insulation (XPS 100 mm, R0 = 3.92) incl. dismantling of the old floor
Windows - NOT replaced; repair and sealing of the frames + new fittings (client's BoQ): lower infiltration (0.20 -> 0.15 ach)
External glazed aluminium doors (thermally broken, 2 x 33.93 m2)
External doors, thermally broken aluminium (24.72 m2) + 24 door closers
External solar shading - canopies above the windows (58 units, Block A)
Ventilation: 72 decentralised units with heat recovery (5 040 m3/h) + kitchen / WC exhaust
Heat pump 2 x 65 kW = 130 kW (COP >= 3.0) - heating and DHW
MTB modular thermal block 2 x 75 kW (solid fuel) - back-up source; ⚠ cost scaled from BoQ 2 x MTB-150
Heating system: radiators + underfloor heating + thermostatic valves + pre-insulated pipework, incl. dismantling of the old system
Solar water heaters: 9 x 300 l thermosiphon units (Block A 5, Block B 4)
Solar photovoltaic plant 96.72 kWp (156 x 620 W, 2 x 50 kW inverters)
LED lighting: 382 luminaires (11.6 kW, 56 with motion sensors)
Replacement of the electric stoves with induction stoves (2 units)
BEMS - building energy management system, BACS class C -> B (EN ISO 52120-1); ⚠ estimated cost (not in the client's BoQ)
Cooling: existing split systems kept (fan coils not in the BoQ) - saving from lower cooling demand only
Electrical network: cabling, distribution boards, sockets/switches, earthing, dismantling
Floors: rebuilding of floor layers and finishes (excl. insulation and dismantling)
Parapet insulation (basalt wool + moisture-resistant gypsum board)
Dismantling of the old brick parapet
Windows: repair of frames, new fittings - MOVED to EE measure 6 (X81)
Foundations: strengthening (reinforced-concrete jacketing), FM-2, porch dismantling
Porches, canopies, bridges, walls, external stairs, fire escape
Internal aluminium glazed partitions (vitraj), 2 x 13.23 m2
